043:1: Why is the time spent on Edentia the most settled and beautiful season of the ascending career, and what do we learn there?
043:4: In Papers 41 and 42 we looked at the physical aspects of the local universe and the relationship of energy, matter, and mind. Now Paper 43 returns to the story of administration and ascension and introduces our constellation, Norlatiadek, and its capital, Edentia. Urantia is number 606 of Satania in Norlatiadek of Nebadon—the six hundred and sixth inhabited world of the system of Satania (43:0.1).
043:5: The constellation government is situated in a cluster of 771 architectural spheres. At the center, Edentia is about one hundred times as large as our world; around it circle seventy major spheres, and around each of these, ten satellites (43:0.2). Here live the permanent citizens, the univitatia, and since the constellation is the midpoint of morontia training, the morontia life there is both typical and ideal (43:0.4).
043:6: What kind of place, then, is Edentia, and who rules it? What marks did the Lucifer rebellion leave here? And what will we learn there?

050:1: If an unseen son leads a primitive world to light and life, what remains for our world, which lost its Prince?
050:4: In Paper 49 we saw how the mortals of countless inhabited worlds differ and yet are one. Now Paper 50 turns to the being who first takes charge of those worlds and rules them—the Planetary Prince. The Planetary Princes belong to the order of Lanonandek Sons, but their service is so highly specialized that they are usually regarded as a separate group (50:0.1).
050:5: They are secondary Lanonandeks who, after receiving Melchizedek certification, are assigned to the reserves on the constellation headquarters, receive various assignments from the System Sovereign, and are at last commissioned as Planetary Princes. When the Life Carriers have developed intelligent evolutionary beings on a planet and ask for an administrative head, the System Sovereign assigns a ruler to that world. Every planet inhabited by evolving mortal creatures has a ruler of this order assigned to it (50:0.1-0.2).
